hypothesis: After owner service SIGKILL with two keys and Button1 held, the outer recovery routine accepts the actual backend event envelope, reconstructs the fsynced ledger, verifies exact service-generation death and unchanged focus/surface/geometry/pointer binding, then releases only the three ledgered inputs and writes a durable verified emergency receipt.
scope: Private isolated Xvfb recovery primitive and cleanup boundary only.
decision_rule: PASS requires independent down and up events and key/button state; owner PID and start ticks match then process is dead; reconstructed ledger contains only a/d and Button1; emergency receipt binds ledger hash and verifies; no normal owner receipt; session stays alive during recovery; Xvfb exits cleanly. Otherwise preserve STOP/FAIL.
